pageDescription: Manage company information, preferences, and data.
companyInformationDescription: Shown on invoices and throughout the app.
emailNotificationsDescription: Send email alerts for low stock and expiring contracts.
companyContactDetailsDescription: Our own company's contact info, shown to staff from customer profiles.
billingPreferencesDescription: Applied to new sales and invoices.
dailyReportSectionsDescription: Drag to reorder, toggle to show/hide, or edit a section's name and visible fields. Changes apply to everyone's Daily Report immediately, including technicians.
editSectionDescription: Change how this section appears on the Daily Report for every user.
productCatalogDescription: Everything offered as a suggestion in the Sale List entry form's Product# field — real Inventory products below, plus a frozen legacy reference further down.
noProductsYet: No products in Inventory yet — click Add Product to create one.
legacyCatalog: Legacy Catalog (historical, no longer added to)
